description: A sibling anomaly to docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json, found during round 5's 115-page cloud/n1ql/ sweep: several Capella pages carry '[ENTERPRISE EDITION]' badges or Enterprise/Community edition citations despite Capella having no edition split at all (edition:enterprise/edition:community is a server/-only concept). Distinct from the version-string anomaly - this is about a licensing-tier badge, not a release-number citation - but the same likely root cause: server/ reference content copied without full adaptation to Capella's model.
